value: U.S. Department of Energy, Advanced Manufacturing Office; prepared by Energetics Incorporated (2021). Understanding the 2018 Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprints. Companion document to the 2018 MECS Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprints (December 2021 - February 2022), 6 pp.

Methodology companion to the 2018 MECS footprint diagrams (doe_2021_001); no technology parameters. Reader's guide to the footprint diagrams: what each box and flow means, and how primary, offsite and onsite energy relate. Copied 2026-10-08 from the modeller's N:\CIMS\Sources\Technologies\EIA MECS\2018 folder (download name understanding_2018_mecs_energy_and_carbon_footprints_1.pdf).
